"So the Priestess was fated not to return.
..................
...You have served us well.
By your strength the mystery is solved,
the fiends have gone to ground, and the
Kingdom is safe. Accept this title and
1,000,000 Gp."
"Hone your skills yet further for what may
come. ...We expect great things of you."

"Oh ho, you say nothing remains to be done?
Then rest easy until new orders are issued."

"I see you continue to hone your skills.
Stay and rest a while."

"So the depths beneath the Shrine truly
are not of this world. The scholars also
report the rock there is most unnatural.
When that great tremor shook the town,
I sent the Royal Guard out for a time.
I am glad you are unharmed. .......
What lies beyond? I am most curious.
I would have you go there at once.
I have readied 10000 Gp each for you."
Before you can say a word, you are handed
10000 Gp and shown out of the chamber.

"At last the quakes in this fortress have
ceased, and the lake has regained its magic.
Yet the Priestess still weighs on me.
Have you found no sign of her yet?"
 
"There is work left for you yet."

"Believe it or not, as you will...
.......that is all a fortune is.
Find the signposts with your own hands."

"It began on a festival night. The fair
Priestess and three guards went to the
Shrine for the yearly rite, which should
have ended as it always did..."

"The Priestess has vanished. The Guard
found bodies at the altar, but no sign
of her. Let me show you what happened.
Truth or illusion? You decide."

"An old friend will be awaiting you.
What he wishes to say, none can know."

"The power of the fiend within the mask...
one day you will have need of it."

"Know you the tale of the man sealed in ice?
His magic will vanish only with his life,
and he shall sleep forever."

"It seems a machine sleeping underground
fouled the lake. Few know the tale of
the fiend that runs that strange machine."

"Friend or foe? One clad in gold
.......shall shake heaven and earth."

"Know you the tale of the chained fiend?
Its vast, green-glowing form terrifies
all, and they say it lies in wait for
those lost in the labyrinth."

"Have you found the three rings? The key
to the secret is hidden on some wall.
The great ring stands for the sky,
the small ring for the earth."

"The idol the heretics made of their god
was unfinished, it seems. What do they
seek, and what do they worship?"

"If you would learn the god's name, go to
the altar once more. ......Some secret
must lie hidden there."

"Have you ever seen a strange machine?
It must be something like a GAME.
....Best not to think too deeply on it."

"You understand it all, I suppose.
What comes after, no one can say."

"Let me show you your past and future.
The past reveals the causes......
.....the future, the fate that awaits.
Now, which would you see?"

"People take me for a kindly sort, but
I do follow the tenets of evil. A healer
with a scary face would frighten the sick.
I've grown old somehow, but I work all
the better for it. What say you?"

"I'm young, but I rolled lots of bonus
points, so I'm a Bishop. Really! I don't
know many spells, but I'm lucky, so I'm
always asked to identify things. Nothing
cursed so far!"

"I tired of adventuring and took to drink,
and now my money's running dry. Let me
join you and earn my bar tab. If I'm about
to die, just leave me behind. I've made
my peace with it."

"My master has gone missing. Where can he
be? I'd like to join you and search for
him. It's all right if we never find him.
I just want to be stronger when we meet
again someday."

"You need help, don't you? Don't worry,
I won't let you down. My strength and
stamina are above average. If I have a
weakness, it's my head... Never mind that.
Will you let me join?"

"Hello! Pardon me for sitting on the table.
I'm so small, I had to get where you could
see me. I'm not fond of bother, but I'll
stay out of your way. You won't regret it,
so let me join you!"

"Hey, how are you? I've just come home to
Ganess after a long time away. New trouble
here dragged me back mid-journey, and my
old comrades are all dead. Even someone
like me wants to help his homeland."

"I hail from the Land of the Rising Sun,
birthplace of samurai and ninja. My sword
is first-rate, but I hate a fuss. Think of
me as rescue crew for the missing, if you
like. I gave up samurai spirit long ago."

"I am a ninja, I am, believe it or not!
A failed one, but I'll train to be a
master. A hidden power awoke in me while
I was playing with a certain item. Truth
is, I was once a petty thief, I was."

"I'm Honey, and my charm is my catlike
quickness. I like to be pampered, but my
claws are sharp, so watch out! I owe the
King for taking me in, so I thought I'd
repay him by helping you. Well?"

"I love to sing, and I'm handy with any
instrument. I wrote the tunes you hear in
this tavern. I love adventure too, and
I'd like to travel with you to hone my
art. These fingers can play anything!"

"I'm of noble birth, believe it or not.
Minor nobility, but my ancestors were
famous in Llylgamyn City. That counts for
little here, but I do have money. Just
don't take it and say 'Bye!', all right?"

"I'm a Valkyrie, a female Lord, you might
say, from an old and noble family. A rich
brat in some town pressed me to marry him,
so I ran. I brought what gear I could, but
I sold my weapon for money."

"Hey now, don't judge me by my face. I only
just turned good, you know. My level's
low, but my vitality is high. My mug means
few friends, but I learn quick. Let me
join, and I'll back you up from the rear."

"Psionic spells are hard. I've grown old
struggling to learn them, but once I do,
other spells should be a breeze. Mind,
it's hard to change careers at my age.
Care to put my hard-won psionics to use?"

"I'm a priest, in active service. Rotten
personality, but my skills are the real
deal! As a healing specialist I'll serve
you well. My only flaw is low vitality.
Well? Let me adventure with you."

"I was born into a line of Monks in a land
of martial artists, and I travel to hone
my skills. Something troubling stirs in
this land. I don't know these parts, so
I hope you'll guide me. Well met!"

"Well, hello. You want to hear about me?
I love beautiful things above all. I hear
a monster in the labyrinth is lovelier
than me, and I want to go with you and
see for myself. How about it?"

"I'm only a novice, but I am a Bishop.
People shun me for my manner, but I'm
proud of my ability. You need someone to
appraise items, don't you? I dislike
danger, so I'll wait here for your finds."

"I was born a bit feeble, so I seem better
suited to Alchemy than fighting. I love
reading, so I don't mind a little boredom.
And I was studying to be a priest until
just now, so I know a few spells."
